sources.name: Insert Coin (Arcade Locator)
sources.example_data_quote: eSpot (Richmond, CA) location_games includes: beatmania IIDX 31 EPOLIS, Dance Dance Revolution A3, Groove Coaster 4MAX, maimai FiNALE, pop'n music UniLab, SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR, WACCA REVERSE, Jubeat Ave., CHUNITHM VERSE (41 total listed machines). Arcade Monterrey (MX) lists Dance Dance Revolution EXTREME among 54 machines. API: GET https://backend.insert-coin.app/api/locations/{uuid}/location_games ; GeoJSON map: GET /api/locations?pagination=false Accept: application/geo+json (7650 features).
sources.adds_over_current: Per-cabinet title lists with versions (e.g. DDR A3, IIDX 31, PIU XX/Phoenix) for many CA/MX venues that ZIv marks other-only or genre-only. Verified adds: Arcade Monterrey map has ddr+other only; IC lists DDR EXTREME + Guitar Hero Arcade + 50 classic cabs. Circus Park Monclova map has pump_it_up; IC specifies Pump It Up XX. Capital City Arcade and ZED*80 are other-only on map; IC has full classic/pinball lineups (55+ cabs at Capital City). Incomplete on some rhythm venues (FreePlay Toronto IC only has pinball; CHQ IC only 5 titles vs richer ZIv). Full location list needs geojson+per-uuid detail (public unfiltered JSON list returns only ~30 FR-centric rows without filters).
sources.note: Best CA/MX find. Crowdsourced bar/arcade/pinball map with open backend API. Strong for classic cabinets and some modern rhythm; coverage uneven by city. Filter by locationGames.game.uuid (e.g. PIU XX, DDR Extreme) works for discovery near lat/lon.

sources.name: Museum of the Game Arcade Map (International Arcade Museum / KLOV)
sources.example_data_quote: Capital City Arcade | 457 E. Columbia St, New Westminster, British Columbia, V3L 3X6, Canada | Bar + Arcade, Classic Machines, Children: Allowed, Food: No, Alcohol: Yes. Phoenix Arcades | Plaza Cuauhtemoc, Av. Cuauhtemoc 19, Roma Nte., Mexico City, 06700. Map API: https://www.arcade-museum.com/api/map and /api/map/details?type=public&id=...
sources.adds_over_current: Useful for discovering retro bars/arcades and addresses (e.g. National Calgary, 8-Bit Beans Whitby, Pinball Alley Edmonton, The Den Vancouver, Phoenix Arcades CDMX). Game tagging appears sparse: /api/gamesList returned empty for sampled IDs; location pages emphasize type (classic/modern) not full music-game cabinets. Does not replace ZIv for bemani lineups. Some CA venues already on map as other-only (Capital City).
sources.note: Live community map focused on classic coin-op and arcade bars. API map endpoint returns large public set; details give address/type. Not a rhythm-game database.

summary: Searched EN/ES/FR for Canada and Mexico rhythm/arcade databases (bemani, DDR, PIU, fliperama, salones de juegos, mapas). Current map: 372 Canada + 91 Mexico, almost all src=ziv; ~228 CA and ~16 MX other-only. No hkarcade.fandom-class regional wiki found for either country. Strongest live multi-venue machine source is Insert Coin (open API, 7650 geo features, verified CA/MX location_games including modern bemani at eSpot/Yume and PIU/DDR at MX sites). Secondary: Museum of the Game Arcade Map (addresses/types, sparse game tags). Official locators: Playdium (5), Rec Room (~12), Circus Park (multi-state MX) give addresses only. FreePlay Toronto publishes a full single-venue game list (DDR EXTREME, JuBeat) matching map genres but is one site. PNWBemani BC forum is live but last meaningful cab updates ~2018 and defers to ZIv/Discord. Recorcholis homepage live but no public /sucursales list (branch names appear in terms text); already partially on map. Pinball Map is pinball-only. No dedicated Mexican rhythm wiki or maintained CA spreadsheet found. Empty result for a full regional machine wiki is itself useful: rely on Insert Coin API + official chain locators + ZIv.
dead_ends: pnwbemani.net Canada (BC) forum: live but stale (CHQ/E-Spot threads last cab inventory posts 2017-2018; site map link points to ZIv). recorcholis.com.mx: live marketing site; /sucursales /ubicaciones 404; no machine lists. pinballmap.com: live API but pinball-only, not music games. freeplaytoronto.com/arcade: excellent single-venue list (DDR EXTREME, JuBeat, 70+ cabs) but not multi-venue. ntnl.ca National Calgary: venue page, not multi-venue DB. Reddit r/bemani Canada threads: point back to ZIv. No Mexican equivalent of hkarcade.fandom or a maintained PIU/DDR spreadsheet confirmed openable with multi-venue machine detail.
